sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when a creature casts a Jutsu within range.

system.description:
You lash out mid-casting, your claws flaring as you manifest a Chakra construct in the shape of a Dragons claw that reaches out to disrupt an offending creature.

First, move up to 20 feet, ending this movement within 5 feet of the triggering creature and make a melee Taijutsu attack targeting them, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage]) + 4d6 damage and forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they are pushed 20 feet away from you and have their Jutsu interrupted. On a successful save they can cast as normal.

Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, on a failed save the affected creature also gains 2 ranks of your nature releases associated condition. (Earth Release: Shaken, Wind Release: Bleed, Fire Release: Burned, Water Release: Chilled, Lightning Release: Shocked)

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6.
